subject: CAIQ walkthrough + evidence handoff / preflight logistics
messages:
From: Kate Morales <kate@novaplan.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ walkthrough + evidence handoff / preflight logistics

Hi Markus / team,

Thanks again for taking this through — Novaplan is scheduled to start our vendor assurance review next week and we wanted to kick off the CAIQ/SIG intake. Can we do a 30–45 minute walkthrough to align on the questionnaire, sample artifacts, and the upload process?

High-level asks from our side:
- Quick run-through of Redwood's CAIQ responses and any callouts (areas you want to flag).
- Where/how you'll drop evidence (S3 link / portal / secure upload).
- Example log extracts (syslog / API access logs) and a sample retention statement.
- Timeline for answers to high-priority questions (we typically lock controls related to access management and logging within 2 weeks).

Proposed times (PST):
- Mon 10/05 10:00–10:45
- Tue 10/06 14:00–14:45
- Wed 10/07 09:00–09:45

Also looping in Procurement (bcc'd) for a quick question on our DPA timeline — we may need a countersigned DPA before artifact access.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Morales
Senior Security Program Manager | Novaplan
security@novaplan.com
[Attachment: novaplan_questionnaire_excerpt.xlsx (XLSX, 95 KB)]
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Kate Morales <kate@novaplan.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ walkthrough + evidence handoff / preflight logistics

Kate — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run the walkthrough. We can do Mon 10/05 at 10:00 PST; I'll book a 45-min slot.

Quick notes ahead of the call so we can keep the session tight:
- We'll cover the CAIQ top-level mapping (what we've already populated) and three live demos: admin console audit, API access logs export, and SSO provisioning.
- Evidence handoff options: secure S3 presigned uploads, temporary read-only share to our evidence bucket via signed link, or direct upload to your Secure Evidence Portal. We prefer presigned S3 links for bulk logs.
- Deliverables we can drop within 48 hours after the call: sample syslog export, auth audit CSV, and a configuration snapshot for key control areas.

I've attached our preflight checklist — please flag anything we should add. Also: who on your side will accept the presigned upload? We'll need an email for the upload ACL.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: redwood_caiq_preflight_checklist.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ walkthrough + evidence handoff / preflight logistics

Kate / Markus — adding a few ops-level details so the call can be actionable: 

- Owners: I've mapped the artifact owners in the attached CSV (runbook-owners.csv). On the call I'll introduce Eric (logs) and Priya (IAM).
- Sample artifacts: we'll make available
  * sample-syslog-export-202609.zip (contains 3 days of anonymized events; retention window noted in README)
  * auth-audit-202609.csv (login/create/delete events)
  * kms-rotation-statement.pdf (summary of rotation cadence)
- Access model: For presigned uploads we need the target email(s) that will receive the presigned link. After upload, we generate a tamper-evident manifest and provide an SHA256 checksum.

I'll join the Mon 10/05 10:00 PST slot and run the demo for syslog export. Markus — if you can confirm the presigned recipients + whether we should redact IPs in the sample or provide a tokenized mapping doc, we'll prepare both.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Thanks — Mon 10/05 10:00 works for us, I'll send the calendar invite.

A couple quick clarifications before the call:
- Will the samples include raw IP addresses? We prefer redacted IPs in bulk copies but could accept a tokenized mapping if you provide it.
- Regarding the DPA: Procurement flagged that we need an executed DPA or a pending DocuSign with an estimated signature date before we authorize full log exports. Is that something you can surface this morning? If not, can you provide a limited read-only preview via the portal?

Thanks,
Kate Morales
Senior Security Program Manager | Novaplan

[Procurement note: procure@novaplan.com asks for an estimated countersign date; they will not authorize full retention artifacts until the DPA is in motion.]
